formation_stages.name: bottom_up_activation
formation_stages.description: Visible question tokens and salient conversation cues activate candidate graph nodes.

formation_stages.name: top_down_control
formation_stages.description: Question intent selects operations such as temporal resolution, multi-hop graph walk, or open-domain bridge.

formation_stages.name: binding
formation_stages.description: Activated entities, aliases, clues, raw spans, and graph paths are bound into a temporary working state.

formation_stages.name: capacity_control
formation_stages.description: Only the highest-activation evidence paths and operations are kept in the working buffer.

activation_algorithm.name: weighted_graph_activation_propagation_v0.1
activation_algorithm.type_balancing: per-type caps prevent high-frequency nodes, especially Person nodes, from dominating the buffer
